resources.string: Create zones at your current location and check when you enter their radius.
Accuracy required to add a zone: ±%1$d m
Allow precise location to get an accuracy estimate.
Waiting for a GPS fix with a known accuracy.
Current accuracy is %1$s; it must be ±%2$d m or better.
Accuracy is good enough. You can add a zone.
Tap a highlighted zone to enter, or switch to automatic mode.
Entry activates after two GPS confirmations.
Allow location access to see nearby zones.
There are no zones nearby. Add one or move closer to an existing zone.
You are inside this zone. Tap to enter manually.
Current coordinates place you inside this zone.
Point the camera at a horizontal surface
You are in a zone. Allow camera access to enable AR placement.
Location access is enabled. Wait for sufficient accuracy before adding a zone.
Allow precise location to add and track zones.
Camera permission is required for AR mode.
Could not get nearby zones. Check your location settings.
Could not track zones. Check your location settings.
The GPS fix has no accuracy estimate. The zone was not added.
The fix accuracy is ±%1$d m, worse than the selected limit of ±%2$d m. Wait for a more accurate location.
You can add a zone when location accuracy is ±%1$d m or better.
You are in zone #%1$d. Point the camera at a horizontal surface.
You are in zone #%1$d. It is closer.
Automatic entry is on. Entry requires two GPS confirmations.
Manual entry is on. Tap a highlighted zone.
You manually entered zone #%1$d. Point the camera at a horizontal surface.
You exited zone #%1$d. Choose a highlighted zone or turn on automatic entry.
